excerpt: When produced at experiments such as the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN, these long-lived particles (LLPs) can decay far from the interaction vertex of the primary proton-proton collision ... requiring customized techniques to identify ... significantly displaced decay vertices.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); J. Alimena, J. Beacham, M. Borsato, Y. Cheng et al. (201 authors)
title: Searching for long-lived particles beyond the Standard Model at the Large Hadron Collider
